card.text: Explore Albiorix, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Albiorix belongs to Saturn’s Gallic group of outer moons. This ellipsoid illustrates a lightcurve-based minimum elongation, with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting the published minimum equatorial ratio 1.34:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes, volume scaling and orientation are assumed. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
